note: A view over committed artefacts, not an approval: it copies each board's own hashes and flags and makes no judgement about the design.  hardware_built and fabrication_approved stay false for every board.

boards.title: Single-pair UCC24624 SR fault-shutdown validation board
boards.what: Two BSC010N04LS6 driven by one real UCC24624, a fault interface and a REG crowbar.  Its purpose is to measure how one SR pair behaves when a fault command arrives, not to pass the converter's current.

boards.title: TLV3501 fast-overcurrent ECO module
boards.what: One TLV3501 comparator and a 2N7002 open-drain pull-down that make the overcurrent channel fast by replacing the three RC filters, not the comparator.  It does not latch.

boards.title: D0 ten-channel protection logic board
boards.what: CD4013 fault latches, the ten-way gate-maximum detector (one Schottky per gate into a 22k/6.2k divider, replacing the ten-resistor sum) and the ACK token, with the POR folded into the latch.  Schematic and ERC only.
not_fabricable_because: no PCB was generated for this board: the repository holds its schematic, netlist, ERC report and BOM, and no copper

boards.title: UCC25600 / UCC24624 control validation board
boards.what: The controller and SR driver wired to their passives so the timing, RT/DT and dead-time assumptions can be measured before the power stage exists.  Schematic and ERC only.
not_fabricable_because: no PCB was generated for this board: the repository holds its schematic, netlist, ERC report and BOM, and no copper

not_here: the main board has no copper; its remaining dependencies are in hardware/dcx_main/remaining_dependencies.md
requires: The two `--fab` commands need KiCad's kicad-cli.  Without it the committed packages can be inspected and hashed, but not rebuilt.
